ngaap.guidance: Q2-15: adjusted diluted EPS $1.01-$1.05 (GAAP $0.89-$0.93; amortization $110m pretax/$85m after-tax/$0.12). FY2015: adjusted diluted EPS lowered to $4.23-$4.33 from $4.30-$4.40 (GAAP $3.74-$3.84; Nobel inventory fair value $20m pretax/$0.02; amortization $439m pretax/$336m after-tax/$0.47); stronger US dollar expected to reduce 2015 EPS by ~$0.07 vs January guidance.
ngaap.notes: 2015 definition: adjusted diluted EPS adds back amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets (new from 2015; tax-effected per item in the bridge labels) and excludes items such as acquisition fair-value inventory/deferred revenue adjustments, significant transaction costs, investment gains, separation costs and discrete tax items. Item amounts from bridge labels. No FCF table in release.
